entities.summary: Zelous Lamar Wheeler is an American former professional baseball third baseman and right fielder who currently serves as a co-hitting coach for the Yomiuri Giants of Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB). He played in NPB for the Tohoku Rakuten Golden Eagles and Giants, and in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the New York Yankees.
